authorization: User requested pushing current code, improving and completing Step6; Step7 only after later approval

candidates.P02_M15: Require current M1 breakout direction equal completed M15 trend
candidates.P03_H1: Require current M1 breakout direction equal completed H1 trend
candidates.P04_BOTH: Require current M1 breakout direction equal both completed M15 and H1 trends
candidates.P05_BOTH_CLOSE: P04 plus BUY midpoint close in upper25% of its M1 range; SELL in lower25%

trend.price: Midpoint close; EMA seeded by first period SMA, then alpha=2/(period+1)
trend.direction: BUY when close>EMA and EMA>EMA three completed bars earlier; SELL mirrored; equality neutral
trend.aggregation: UTC buckets from complete observed M1 quote bars; require all15 or60 distinct consecutive minute opens
trend.availability: Only at bucket close; current forming candle unavailable; stale if age>=higher timeframe duration
trend.gaps: Missing M1 invalidates its entire higher-timeframe aggregate; no interpolation; EMA retains prior observed complete bars across market gaps

comparison.common_baseline: P01 entries only when both higher timeframes are ready; same readiness mask as all four candidates
comparison.unchanged: All entry sizing, Bid/Ask, stops, targets, profit policy, fees, day/session limits and one-position envelope remain P01
comparison.source_model: Previously examined generated January/February2024 ticks; conservative target fill and0.01USC rounding
comparison.additional_in_sample_window: 2024-03-01 broker midnight through2024-03-15 exclusive, UTC+2; evaluate every declared candidate once without selecting or changing parameters first
comparison.not_holdout: All windows remain inside declared Step6 eraD; no2026 prices or Step7 holdout evaluation
comparison.improvement_screen: MeanR and netUSC higher than common baseline in January, February and additional March window; pooled p99 drawdown lower; nonempty BUY and SELL populations; report retention and bootstrap uncertainty. This is a screen, not qualification.
comparison.selection: At most one candidate passing all screen conditions, ranked by pooled meanR; no automatic parameter search or extension of batch
comparison.deployment: No candidate replaces the active demo EA during this research

gates: Original G1–G9 unchanged, including1000 trades and200 matched random schedules per era. Full four-era data and baseline remain prerequisites.

test_seams.features: Closed higher-timeframe availability, strict missing-minute rejection, future-prefix invariance and mirrored direction
test_seams.replay: Unfiltered fork must reproduce P01; candidate filters may only suppress entries, never enlarge risk or alter protective exit rules
